entities.name: An-Havva
entities.description: A settlement at the edge of the Great Wood on Ulgrotha, a trading hub between Koskun and Aysen.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Land from which An-Havva's pioneers came.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: Guardian of the wood fond of An-Havva's inhabitants, who opened the Lady's Path for them.

entities.name: An-Havva Inn
entities.description: Finest eating and drinking establishment on the road, owned by the town's Constables.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Met Serra and Baron Sengir at the inn.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Met Feroz and Baron Sengir at the inn.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Met Feroz and Serra at the inn.

entities.name: Zeki
entities.description: Leader of undead pirates known in the town.

events.summary: Pioneers from Aysen founded An-Havva by the Wood.
events.quote: It was founded by pioneers from Aysen

events.summary: The Autumn Willow opened the Lady's Path for the town's inhabitants.
events.quote: opening for them the Lady's Path

events.summary: The first encounter between Feroz, Serra and Baron Sengir took place at An-Havva Inn.
events.quote: It was here that the first encounter between Feroz , Serra and Baron Sengir took place.

relations.quote: The Constables of An-Havva are the owners of An-Havva Inn
